dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Uses COPY with REPLACING using // delimiters, INDEXED file organization, and shell integration patterns typical of ORCA system.
evidence: SELECT ... ASSIGN RECE41PARA ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED
no EXEC CICS or EXEC SQL

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) processing system - monthly business receipt file creation for injury/pension and self-pay claims
purpose.summary: This program is part of the JMA ORCA standard medical receipt software system. It creates monthly business receipt detail files for injury compensation and self-pay (労災・自賠責) claims. It processes indexed files containing patient insurance information, disease names, and point/amount claim data to generate receipt output files.

notable_features: 37 COPY statements with REPLACING using // delimiter syntax
Multiple indexed sequential files (RECE41, RECE43, RECE47, RECE471)
Japanese text in comments (EUC-JP encoding rendered as latin-1)
OCCURS tables for hospital/system management data
No COMP-3 usage despite financial data
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
verdict.notes: Source file is encoded in EUC-JP (Japanese) but decoded as latin-1, causing mojibake in comment text. The program is clearly part of the well-known JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt system used widely in Japanese medical clinics. File truncated at 16000 chars out of 163766 bytes total (3784 lines), but enough structure is visible for confident classification.
